pool.name: Pro Database
pool.tagline: Thousands of pros, from superstars to squad fillers.
pool.description: A deep ratings database built from the FIFA 15-23 player data (2014 to the 2022-23 season): players still active then, plus retired players at their best rating in the data. Rated 70 and up, so later phases have a long tail of cheaper players.

credit.author: sofifa.com via the FIFA 15-23 player dataset (EA ratings)
